description.en_EN: Every SMART attribute of every disk, with its current value, its worst and the manufacturer threshold. A row is named by disk AND attribute, because the same attribute exists on every disk in the box and merging them would chart one disk as all of them.
description.es_ES: Cada atributo SMART de cada disco, con su valor actual, el peor y el umbral del fabricante. Una fila se nombra por disco Y atributo, porque el mismo atributo existe en todos los discos y fusionarlos graficaría uno como si fueran todos.

_comment_row_split: A row is named '<disk> / <attribute>' because index_label names two columns and the sampler joins them. Which half is the DISK is a fact about this table, so the table says it: every attribute of one disk then reads under that disk's heading instead of eighty rows sorted by attribute name across every bay.
_comment_serial: diskSMARTSerialNumber is the exact link between this table and SYNOLOGY-DISK-MIB: both name the same physical disk by its serial. Without it the two tables only share a naming convention — the disk table says "Drive 1" and this one says "sda" — and pairing them by position is a guess that points at the wrong disk the day a bay is empty, which is exactly the day somebody is reading SMART.
